instruction: Copy the image file OIP.jpg from your home directory to the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened file manager, found OIP.jpg, opened terminal, tried ImageMagick convert with wrong filename (QIP.jpg instead of OIP.jpg), installed imagemagick, still failed due to filename error and policy restrictions, eventually opened image in Image Viewer and tried Print to File but ran out of turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open file manager, open terminal, run shell commands (ls, cp, mv, apt install, find), install packages with sudo, open images in Image Viewer, interact with Print dialog, navigate folders in dialogs
metadata.failure_analysis: Model misread filename as QIP.jpg instead of OIP.jpg, wasted many turns on wrong convert commands. ImageMagick also had policy restrictions. Eventually found correct filename but ran out of 50 turns before completing the print-to-file approach.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a basic file copy operation. The model demonstrated ability to use terminal commands including ls and file operations. Copying a file is a single-step task well within the model's capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires copying OIP.jpg from /home/user/ to /home/user/Desktop/. Evaluator uses vm_command_line to list Desktop contents and check_include_exclude to verify OIP.jpg is present.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'ls /home/user/Desktop/' to list files on the Desktop, which will include OIP.jpg if the copy succeeded.
Metric check_include_exclude correctly receives the rules dict directly (via get_rule) and checks if 'OIP.jpg' is present in the ls output string.
Data flow is semantically correct: ls output (string) -> check if 'OIP.jpg' substring exists -> return 1.0 or 0.0.
Expected values are correct: include=['OIP.jpg'] matches the file specified in the instruction.
Minor gap: evaluator does not verify the source file still exists at /home/user/OIP.jpg (distinguishing copy from move), but destination verification is the primary requirement.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optionally add a second check to verify /home/user/OIP.jpg still exists, to distinguish copy from move.
